cast: hero (you, black head, blue hoodie, NO balance ever)
mom (at home kitchen, pays electric bill)

script.text: You are standing in the lunch line when it happens. Above the cashier's head, a number appears. Forty dollars.
What if you could see how much money everyone has?

script.beat: 3 bathroom rule: nothing above your head
script.text: Rule three, you can't see your own number. You stand in front of the bathroom mirror and look up. Nothing.
You test rule two that night at home. Your mom pays the electric bill on her phone. One tap. Her number drops one hundred and twelve dollars in a single blink.

shots.note: Wide cafeteria lunch line (classroom set reused as cafeteria); hero in blue hoodie mid-line, no number visible yet; trays, steam, lunch crowd
Close-up: Mrs. Park the cashier at the till; a soft white $40 pill appears nearly touching her head; hero stares, face swaps neutral to shock
Macro insert: the $40 pill HUGE, soft white, floating like a price tag; blurred cafeteria behind
Title card on the dark void: glowing pill, then WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE / HOW MUCH MONEY EVERYONE HAS? in yellow caps
Close-up: hero at the bathroom mirror; his reflection has NO pill above its head; red label NOTHING ABOVE YOUR HEAD
Close-up: hero looks up at the mirror, then at his own head; empty space above; his face falls
Medium home kitchen at night: Mom at the table with her phone; hero watches from the doorway; her pill above her head
Close-up: Mom taps her phone to pay the electric bill; her pill flashes red
Extreme close-up: Mom's pill drops $112 in a single blink, flashing red; her face calm, unaware (her starting balance is never given)
